headline: Intel Q3 earnings due October 29 after close; JPMorgan upgrade to Neutral seen as sentiment floor
summary: Intel's Q3 2026 earnings are due after the market close on October 29. JPMorgan's October 19 upgrade to Neutral (from Underweight) — the first upgrade in four years — is seen by analysts as a potential sentiment floor for INTC after its ~36% decline from the June peak.
key_facts: Intel Q3 2026 earnings due after close Oct 29
JPMorgan upgrade Oct 19 first in 4 years; seen as sentiment floor
Intel ~36% below June 2026 peak at ~$89.85
JPMorgan $85 target for Dec 2027

headline: Barclays: Tesla-SpaceX merger announcement possible before December; Tesla AGM due by Dec 6
summary: Barclays analysts said a formal Tesla-SpaceX merger announcement before December is possible but timing is tight. Tesla's AGM is due by December 6, and December 3 is the projected date. With the definitive proxy carrying no merger vote, any announcement before the meeting would need to be added as a special item.
key_facts: Barclays: merger announcement possible in late October or early November
Tesla AGM due by Dec 6 (projected Dec 3)
Current definitive proxy has no merger vote on ballot
Musk would control ~56% of votes in combined company
Barclays combined valuation estimate ~$3.5T

headline: Dow futures +0.22% while S&P and Nasdaq futures fell as Brent surged above $111 and Nvidia/AI faced pressure early Oct 21
summary: Early October 21 premarket showed divergence: Dow futures up 0.22% while S&P and Nasdaq futures initially fell as Brent crude surged above $111 and Nvidia/AI stocks faced pressure from Iran cable threats. This reversed as SpaceX earnings and chip sector rebound took hold later in the session.
key_facts: Early premarket Oct 21: Dow futures +0.22%, S&P and Nasdaq futures fell
Brent surged above $111 briefly
Iran cable threat pressured Nasdaq/tech
SpaceX earnings reversed tech weakness mid-session
